title: Fix setup.sh: detect already-installed cryptography, don't hard-fail on PEP 668 systems
description: setup.sh calls 'pip install --user cryptography' and hard-exits if pip refuses (PEP 668, externally-managed Python). Debian/Ubuntu and recent Python.org distributions return non-zero from pip --user when the package is already system-installed. The smart fix: probe 'python -c "import cryptography"' first, skip pip install if it succeeds, then try pip with progressively relaxed flags only if the probe fails. Code lives at setup.sh:49-56.
close_reason: Fix shipped via /tmp heredoc → cp to setup.sh; probe detected cryptography 49.0.0 already importable, skipped pip; ./setup.sh ran clean.

title: Real-produce: CLI + Interface + Monitoring + Persistent state + Setup
description:
Build the production runtime layer for rollout-shield beyond the spec docs:

1. CLI: rollout-shield command with subcommands (install, status, claim, verify, monitor, dashboard, reputation, keys)
2. Web interface: dashboard served by the CLI at /. Shows claim graph, agent reputation leaderboard, recent claims feed, box health
3. Monitoring daemon: long-running Python process with persistent state. Periodic health checks, alert dispatch, restarts on transient failures
4. Persistent state: claim graph cache, reputation index, alert history — survives daemon restart via JSON-on-disk
5. Setup: top-level setup.sh that installs CLI + monitoring + creates state directories + generates agent keypair if missing
6. GitHub Action: workflow that runs the monitoring daemon in CI mode (one-shot health report)

Tech: Python 3 stdlib only (no external deps for portability). HTTP server via http.server. Vanilla HTML+JS for the interface.

Composition with existing layers:
- protocol/ spec defines the claim format — the CLI emits claims in that format
- tools/ scripts are referenced by the CLI (no duplication of logic)
- .github/actions/setup-bd is extended to also install the rollout-shield CLI for CI use
- agent/ spec defines agent identity — the CLI loads the agent's key from .beads/keys/

Acceptance: rollout-shield install && rollout-shield status && rollout-shield monitor --daemon && rollout-shield dashboard all work end-to-end on a fresh checkout. Monitoring writes persistent state. Dashboard renders claim graph.
